claims.text: The span detector is part of an extended Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) architecture that includes a memory generation layer, a lexicon encoding layer, and a contextual layer.
The span detector uses a multi-turn answer module and employs a bilinear function to determine the start and end points of answer spans.
The architecture also includes a binary classifier to determine if a question is unanswerable, which is optimized jointly with the span detector.
